title: Partial Breakdown of Integrability in Nearly Integrable Systems
summary: We study the persistence of integrable structures in real-analytic nearly integrable systems under perturbations that may destroy some, but not all, of these structures. Specifically, we establish upper bounds on the numbers of real-analytic first integrals -- quantities conserved by the motion -- and commuting vector fields -- infinitesimal generators of continuous symmetries -- that can persist under the perturbation.
